items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You know the girl that's playing piano. Yeah, it's Louise Delvar. ... [INTERVIEWEE] My wife can spell that.

ctx.x: Okay, excuse the interruption. I thought as long as we had that, I was interested to see what other groups were there that night. Now let's see, this is Remy Golden Leaf Orchestra. Is that the, that's Joe Harris's father? Yeah. And who is the banjo? That's Eddie Dawson. That's what I thought, that's what the Harold Dejan does. And you're over here on tuba. You don't know the other sax players. I don't know. You know the girl that's playing piano. Yeah, it's Louise Delvar. She's dead. Oh, she's dead. Louise, how…
My wife can spell that. How's it pronounced again?
